papers.title: High power laser powder bed fusion of Inconel 718 alloy: Effect of laser focus shift on formability, microstructure and mechanical properties
papers.first_author_affiliation: Wuhan National Laboratory for Optoelectronics, Huazhong University of Science and Technology, Wuhan 430074, China

corresponding_authors.name: Kaiwen Wei
corresponding_authors.affiliation: Wuhan National Laboratory for Optoelectronics, Huazhong University of Science and Technology, Wuhan 430074, China

llm.relevance_to_user: 该论文研究Inconel 718合金的激光粉末床熔融工艺参数影响，完全不涉及生物医学植入物或多孔结构。
llm.why_not_core: This paper focuses on LPBF of a nickel superalloy for non-biomedical applications, with no porous structure design, stress shielding analysis, fatigue testing, surface roughness quantification, or osseointegration context.

summary_zh.motivation: 研究激光焦点偏移对Inconel 718合金LPBF成形质量的影响
summary_zh.method: 通过实验改变焦点位置，分析成形性、微观组织和力学性能
summary_zh.result: 焦点偏移显著影响熔池形貌、缺陷和拉伸性能
summary_zh.validation: 实验表征：金相、XRD、拉伸测试

summary_en.motivation: To investigate the effect of laser focus shift on the formability, microstructure, and mechanical properties of Inconel 718 fabricated by high-power LPBF.
summary_en.method: Experimental study with varying laser focus positions, followed by characterization of density, defects, microstructure, and tensile properties.
summary_en.result: Laser focus shift significantly affects melt pool geometry, porosity, and mechanical anisotropy, with optimal properties achieved at a specific shift.
summary_en.validation: Validation through optical microscopy, X-ray diffraction, and tensile testing of as-built specimens.
